subtasks.title: Write tests for subtask scheduling functions
subtasks.description:
Create subtask_scheduling_test.go with tests that exercise the three functions being extracted: scheduleSubtasks, dispatchPendingSubtasks, and orderCandidatesByExperimentPriority. These functions already have coverage in existing test files (scheduling_test.go, experiment_scheduling_test.go, dedup_scheduling_test.go, dispatch_stall_test.go), but this subtask creates a focused test file in the new location to verify the functions remain accessible after extraction.

Write 3 tests:
1. TestScheduleSubtasks_SkipsWhenNoCandidates — create a parent task with no backlog subtasks, call scheduleSubtasks, assert no error and no state changes.
2. TestDispatchPendingSubtasks_SkipsTerminalParents — create a parent in StatusDone with a backlog subtask, call dispatchPendingSubtasks, assert the subtask remains in backlog (not dispatched).
3. TestOrderCandidatesByExperimentPriority_NilScheduler — call orderCandidatesByExperimentPriority with experimentScheduler=nil, assert candidates returned unchanged.

Use testutil.NewTestDB for DB setup. Use testutil.CreateProject and testutil.CreateTask for entity creation. The Orchestrator struct is in orchestrator.go — instantiate with: o := &Orchestrator{db: db, projectID: project.ID, logger: slog.Default()}. Set o.experimentScheduler = nil for test 3.

These tests verify behavioral contracts that must hold after the file move.

subtasks.title: Integration verification
subtasks.description:
Verify the extraction is correct end-to-end:
1. Run `wc -l internal/orchestrator/task_processing.go` — must be ≤800 lines
2. Run `wc -l internal/orchestrator/subtask_scheduling.go` — should be ~390 lines
3. Run `gofmt -l internal/orchestrator/subtask_scheduling.go internal/orchestrator/task_processing.go` — must produce no output
4. Run `go vet ./internal/orchestrator/...` — must pass
5. Run `go test ./internal/orchestrator/... -count=1` — all existing tests must pass
6. Run `grep -c '^func ' internal/orchestrator/subtask_scheduling.go` — must be exactly 3
7. Run `grep -c '^func ' internal/orchestrator/task_processing.go` — must be exactly 5

This subtask does not need to create or modify any files — it only validates. If any check fails, fix the issue in the relevant file.

No new features, no documentation changes needed — this is a same-package file split with zero user-facing impact.

assumptions.decision: Extract all three functions together into one file rather than splitting across multiple files
alternatives: Extract only orderCandidatesByExperimentPriority (smallest, ~62 lines) to minimally meet the 800-line ceiling
Extract each function to its own file
assumptions.why_chosen: The three functions form a coherent scheduling concern (scheduleSubtasks is the core, dispatchPendingSubtasks is its catch-all caller, orderCandidatesByExperimentPriority is a helper it uses). Extracting them together keeps related logic co-located and produces a well-scoped file.
subtask_scheduling.go matches the task description's naming and accurately describes the file's contents — scheduling logic for subtasks.
